description: This file represents the code-behind for an ASP.NET WebForms page (AdminCourseQueue.aspx.cs) that manages the admin queue functionality in the Online Examination System. It handles session validation, database queries to check if a course queue is empty, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminCourseQueue ASP.NET page, handling page load logic, session validation, database operations, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Checks session variables, validates course queue in the database, and performs cleanup if the queue is empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the same AdminQueue page (likely an oversight).

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to LoginPage.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a row in GridView, storing specific cell values in session variables and navigating to ShowAns page.
